summary.text: The impassable dunes are a Western Desert natural wonder of hundreds of thousands of sand dunes that keep moving along a fixed curved path.

claims.text: Winds blow as sand scatters in the air over a huge area of sand dunes that move slowly while fierce wind darkens the sky.
Hundreds of thousands of dunes travel a fixed curved path with no oases, beasts, or rocks, only yellow sand.

Behind Xiao clan’s spider battlefield lies a huge dune area already shifting slowly under fierce wind while the sky darkens. Xiao clan Gu Masters hold formation against hidden sand spiders there. The spiders are the size of elephants, covered in glazed exoskeleton, and skilled at moving in sand. An aerial count estimates at least thirty thousand of them, and the clan’s experience keeps the fight tilted toward the humans.

That dune motion ranks among Western Desert’s seven most famous natural wonders. The path holds no oases, no beasts, and no rocks, only yellow sand, and even rank eight Gu Immortals are powerless to stop it. Western Desert’s people named the dunes from that helplessness toward nature’s might.
Fang Yuan reaches the impassable dunes in the Western Desert by Fixed Immortal Travel.

Xiao clan Gu Immortals fight on the dunes as well, but only at the periphery. Even they cannot explore the inner areas. Their opponents are three hidden sand spider queens, each a desolate beast, releasing more spiders into the sandstorm. Xiao Hu Chi leads the Immortal group, with Xiao Shi Rang as deputy. Their aims are training the clan’s Gu Masters and capturing the queens to raise at headquarters, where queen blood and flesh support refining of mortal spider Gu for Ten Thousand Li Silk Corridor.

Fang Yuan flies in, takes one weakened queen with a strength path giant hand, and opens a long-term regretful spider trade with Xiao clan on the spot. Xiao clan ranks among Western Desert’s richest super forces because it holds the Immortal Gu House Ten Thousand Li Silk Corridor, which spreads trade across the region and burns through large numbers of mortal spider Gu to stay in use.
